principles.rule: Never delete existing content automatically; preserve, review, migrate, or redirect.
Every published experience has one canonical route and one declared purpose.
Every primary page exposes one clear primary user action.
Motion and visual effects must degrade gracefully and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Payments, identity, investment, advertising, and user-generated publishing require explicit state, consent, auditability, and appropriate controls.
Production readiness is evidenced by automated tests and live verification, not configuration alone.
Every production change must be reversible through version control and deployment rollback.
